title: Another site's requests are refused, whoever is signed in
steps: Use the app as usual: edit a note, open the calendar, install Word count from the Catalog. Everything the app's own page asks works as before.

From another site's console (any page), run fetch("<this Preview>/api/file", { method: "PUT", mode: "no-cors", headers: { "Content-Type": "text/plain" }, body: JSON.stringify({ path: "From elsewhere.md", text: "x", base: 0 }) }). No note called From elsewhere appears here.
